name: CreateAccessPoint

parameters.help_en:
The AgenticSpace ID.
>This parameter is required for Agentic file systems
parameters.name: agentic_space_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the permission group.

This parameter is required if the file system is a General-purpose NAS file system.

Default permission group: DEFAULT_VPC_GROUP_NAME (the default permission group for VPCs).
>Not supported for Agentic file systems
parameters.help_zh:
权限组名称。

当目标文件系统为通用型NAS，此参数必填。

默认权限组：DEFAULT_VPC_GROUP_NAME（专有网络默认权限组）。
>Agentic文件系统不支持
parameters.name: access_group

parameters.help_en: The name of the access point
parameters.name: access_point_name

parameters.help_en:
The root directory of the access point.
Default value: "/". If the access point directory does not exist, you must also specify the OwnerUserId and OwnerGroupId parameters.
>Supported only for Agentic file systems
parameters.help_zh:
接入点根目录。
默认值为“/”， 如果接入点目录不存在，则还需要填写OwnerUserId和OwnerGroupId参数。
>仅Agentic文件系统支持
parameters.name: root_directory

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable access point policy.
Valid values:

- true: enabled.
- false (default): not enabled.

> After you enable access point policy for the access point, all Resource Access Management (RAM) users are denied access to mount and access data through the access point by default. You must grant the corresponding access permissions through authorization and then mount and access the file system through the access point. After you disable access point policy, the access point allows anonymity mounting. For more information about how to configure access point permissions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2545998.html.

>For Agentic file systems, this parameter must be set to true
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用RAM策略。
取值：

- true：开启
- false（默认值）：不开启

> 启用接入点RAM策略以后，缺省禁止所有RAM账号使用接入点挂载和访问数据，您需要为账号进行授权开放对应访问权限，并通过接入点进行挂载访问。禁用后，接入点允许匿名挂载。关于如何配置接入点权限，关于如何配置接入点权限，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2545998.html。

>Agentic文件系统时，取值必须为 true
parameters.name: enabled_ram

parameters.help_en:
The owner user ID.

This parameter is required if the RootDirectory directory does not exist.
>Not supported for Agentic file systems
parameters.help_zh:
属主用户ID。

当RootDirectory目录不存在时，该参数必填。
>Agentic文件系统不支持
parameters.name: owner_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The owner group ID.

This parameter is required if the RootDirectory directory does not exist.
>Not supported for Agentic file systems
parameters.help_zh:
属主用户组ID。

当RootDirectory目录不存在时，该参数必填。
>Agentic文件系统不支持
parameters.name: owner_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The POSIX permission. Default value: "0755". The value must be a four-digit octal number that starts with 0.

This parameter takes effect only after you specify the OwnerUserId and OwnerGroupId parameters.
>Not supported for Agentic file systems
parameters.help_zh:
POSIX权限。默认值为“0755”。限制：必须以0开头的四位八进制数字。

当填写OwnerUserId和OwnerGroupId参数后，此字段生效。
>Agentic文件系统不支持
parameters.name: permission

parameters.help_en:
The POSIX user ID.
>Not supported for Agentic file systems
parameters.name: posix_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The POSIX group ID.
>Not supported for Agentic file systems
parameters.help_zh:
Posix用户组ID。

parameters.name: posix_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The secondary group IDs. Separate multiple group IDs with commas (,).
>Not supported for Agentic file systems
parameters.help_zh:
第二用户组。多个用户组ID时，使用半角逗号（,）分隔。
>Agentic文件系统不支持
parameters.name: posix_secondary_group_ids

element_fields.help_en:
The tag key.
Limits:

- Cannot be empty or an empty string.
- Can be up to 128 characters in length.
- Cannot start with aliyun or acs:.
- Cannot contain http:// or https://
element_fields.help_zh:
标签键。
限制：

- 不允许为空和空字符串。
- 最多支持 128 个字符。
- 不能以aliyun或acs:开头。
- 不能包含http://和https://
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The tag value.
Limits:

- Cannot be empty or an empty string.
- Can be up to 128 characters in length.
- Cannot contain http:// or https://
element_fields.help_zh:
标签值。
限制：

- 不允许为空和空字符串。
- 最多支持 128 个字符。
- 不能包含http://和https://
element_fields.name: value
